qa_pairs.question: How has the legal framework for granting exemptions on import duty and regulatory duties for Economic Zones and High-Tech Parks transitioned over time according to the provided SROs?
qa_pairs.answer: The legal basis for granting these duty exemptions has transitioned from the Customs Act, 1969 (section 19(1)), as seen in SROs from 2015 [0, 1, 2, 3] and 2020 [4], to the Customs Act, 2023 (section 25(1)), as evidenced in the 2024 SRO [5]. These exemptions are granted by the government in consultation with the National Board of Revenue for purposes such as the establishment of Economic Zones and High-Tech Parks.
